title: Web3OpenAI
tagline: Inteligent AI Dashboard integrating GUI Ux with web3 technology.
description: The Inteligent AI Dashboard is a graphical user interface (GUI) that allows users to interact with web3-based decentralized applications (Dapps). The Dashboard provides users with a visual representation of their account balances, transaction history, and smart contract interactions. In addition, the Dashboard allows users to create and manage their own Dapps.
how_its_made: The Inteligent AI Dashboard is a GUI tool that allows users to interact with web3-enabled applications using NFTPort, IPFS, Python and OPENAI technologies. It allows users to view and manage their NFTPort-enabled applications in a single, convenient location. The Dashboard also provides a variety of features and tools to help users get the most out of their web3 experience.
